label: Windows loopMIDI + Reaper Basic
requirements: Node.js 22.x on the Windows bridge host
loopMIDI or equivalent virtual MIDI loopback installed
Reaper configured to listen to the same virtual port name

inboundMidi: Host CC feedback enters the bridge on the same named loopMIDI port

expectedTelemetry: Reaper sees incoming CC changes on the loopMIDI port
The bridge console shows connected serial and ready device state
manualValidationChecklist: Confirm the exact loopMIDI port name matches the bridge MIDI label
Record one CC automation lane in Reaper from live knob movement
Send one CC back from Reaper and verify feedback suppression prevents immediate loops
